title: Engineering spin states of metal sites toward advanced lithium–sulfur batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,3553-3567
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05582A, Review Article
Xiaomin Zhang, Xiaoyu Zhang, Xingbo Wang, Guoliang Cui, Hongge Pan, Wenping Sun
This review highlights the progress in spin state modulation of transition metal sites to enhance Li–S battery performance, focusing on strategies for modulating spin states and their role in improving catalytic activity for polysulfide conversion.
